codeReview.summary: Reviewed both handoff commits for this feature - e5c6e296 (attempt 1, 76 files: message settings, waitlist screens, Sites notify-me/waitlist UI, guards) and 5e7c5b12 (completion, 22 files: floor Seat prompt swap/move/overbook, Sites zone notes, shared-schema contract test, Playwright spec) - against the feature description/expectedBehavior, architecture.md and the assigned focus areas. The current combined tree was judged, with later fix commit 2c411941 (tenant-api trailing slashes, shared waitlist schemas, occupied-table seat, hold areaPref) and 661d65a5 included as context. (1) Guards: every new loader/action awaits requireReservationsAccess first - settings.messages.tsx:10, settings.waitlist.tsx:9, waitlist.tsx:12 - and reservations-guards.test.ts enumerates all three files and asserts no pre-guard formData/json/db use. (2) Flag gating: sections.ts:66-71 gives the waitlist section feature 'waitlist'; requireReservationsFeature (access.server.ts:81-86) 404s unless master and child flags are on; today.tsx:635 renders TodayWaitlistCard only when waitlistEnabled; the floor shows the waitlist panel and drop handling only when waitlistEnabled && canManage; the Sites waitlist page 404s unless the public gate reports waitlist. Message settings gate on the settings section with waitlist message kinds filtered by visibleKinds (messages-view.ts). (3) Browser-direct token: App loaders return only orgSlug/canManage/flags/dataRegion; all guest data flows from useReservationsScopeClient to tenant-api with the short-lived operator token; waitlist.astro passes only org name, flags and a phone example - no guest PII through App/Sites SSR. (4) i18n: an exhaustive check of the .po diffs found 207 new App msgids, all with non-empty Arabic msgstr (the only two absent strings, 'Seat anyway' and the long overbook hint, are obsolete '#~' entries replaced in 5e7c5b12) and 60 new Sites msgids present and non-empty in all five non-source locales (ar/de/es/fr/zh); aria-live announcements, occupant lines, enum labels and option tables are Lingui-wrapped. (5) Design system: amber status styling is explicitly allowed by shadcn/no-raw-colors; the no-restyle failure was fixed by wrapping AlertDescription content in a div; native selects match the established reservations-area pattern. (6) VAL-WAIT-019: use-floor-waitlist.ts:91-99 asks the server first and opens the prompt only on a 409 table_occupied; WaitlistSeatPrompt names the occupant (floor-waitlist-panel.tsx:247, OccupantLine:319) and offers only the server-named resolutions (swap:267-279, move:280+); the Seat dialog gets the same swap/move buttons; component tests (floor-waitlist.test.tsx, waitlist-screen.test.tsx) and the Playwright spec cover the flow. (7) Carried-over gaps: Sites time chips show slot.areaLabel (flow.ts:376, covers VAL-ONLINE-045); the detail sheet shows reservation.client via clientLabel in a Badge (detail-sheet.tsx:848-849, hidden for operator); settings.special-days.tsx:103 defaults to serviceDayBusinessDate(Date.now(), locationTimeZone). The new Playwright spec (apps/app/tests/e2e/reservations-waitlist-messages.test.ts) stubs tenant-api and covers messages save, waitlist notify + seat swap, waitlist settings save, and floor drop with Arabic RTL (dir=rtl assert at :543-546); the handoff reports 4 tests x 3 repeats pass. No blocking issue found; the notes below are non-blocking.

issues.description: Message settings and waitlist settings share the location-settings row version with general settings: rsv-message-settings-service.ts:96-165 checks expectedVersion against the same row.version that updateLocationSettings manages, and rsv-waitlist-settings.ts:47-60 deliberately delegates to updateLocationSettings 'so the version check and audit row stay in one place'. Saving message or waitlist settings therefore bumps the version an open general-settings screen holds, so its next save 409s (and vice versa). Both new screens handle it recoverably - waitlist-settings.tsx:84,212-216 shows a conflict banner with reload, and messages-view.ts:187-190 rebases the draft - and the general settings screen already shows a stale_version banner. Acceptable design, but a validator walking two settings screens in parallel windows should expect a recoverable 409.

Evidence limitation, not a defect: the floor drop test (and the agent-browser checks) dispatch a synthetic DragEvent sequence with a hand-built DataTransfer, because Playwright's mouse API does not drive HTML5 drag and drop in Chromium. The test therefore proves the drop-handler wiring (drag type detection, server-first seat, prompt) but not the native drag pipeline. library/user-testing.md:180 already records this workaround for validators. The handler reads the same DataTransfer the browser produces on a real drag, so the residual risk is low.

sharedStateObservations.observation: tenant-api reservations waitlist routes are registered both with and without a trailing slash via the local helper `both` (apps/tenant-api/src/routes/reservations-waitlist.ts:100, used at :143, :206, :243, :278, :309, :341). The attempt-1 worker hit a 404 because the App called slashless paths while the routes were registered with a slash; commit 2c411941 fixed it backend-side instead of changing the client. Nothing in library/engine-notes.md or architecture.md records this convention, so a future route author adding a waitlist-style operator route (or a new client) may reintroduce the mismatch.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: apps/tenant-api/src/routes/reservations-waitlist.ts:100 `const both = (path) => [path, `${path}/`]` with seven call sites; handoff 2026-10-17T08-25-44-475Z__messages-and-waitlist-ui__fc64f30c lists the trailing-slash 404 under discoveredIssues; fix commit 2c411941.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The location settings version is a single shared row version across three App surfaces: general settings, waitlist settings and message settings. This coupling is not documented anywhere (library/app-ui-patterns.md:154 only says every mutation sends expectedVersion and reloads on stale_version). Future settings screens must read the version from the same location-settings payload and handle stale_version, or they will 409 each other.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: apps/tenant-api/src/services/rsv-waitlist-settings.ts:47-60 delegates to updateLocationSettings; apps/tenant-api/src/services/rsv-message-settings-service.ts:96,154-165 compares against row.version; recovery in apps/app/app/components/reservations/waitlist/waitlist-settings.tsx:84,212-216 and apps/app/app/utils/reservations/messages-view.ts:187-190.

sharedStateObservations.observation: Minor skill-text drift: app-ui-worker SKILL.md step 10 describes `commands.typecheck_app (4 GB heap)`, but services.yaml:45-46 documents the working command as a direct tsc run with --max-old-space-size=6144 (NODE_OPTIONS). The worker's first `npx turbo run typecheck` attempt hit a Node OOM (the gate script sets 4096) and the services.yaml command then succeeded, so the worker lost time to the turbo route that the skill text implies. Aligning the skill's parenthetical with services.yaml would avoid the detour.

summary: Pass. Both commits (e5c6e296, 5e7c5b12) and the current combined code were reviewed against the feature's description/expectedBehavior, architecture.md and the seven assigned focus areas. Guards, flag gating, browser-direct token handling, i18n (207 new App msgids with Arabic filled, 60 new Sites msgids across all six locales), design-system policy, VAL-WAIT-019 occupied-table swap/move/overbook behavior, the three carried-over gaps, and the new stubbed Playwright spec (4 tests, Arabic RTL) all check out with concrete evidence. The trailing-slash and shared-schema gaps reported in attempt 1 were resolved by later commits (2c411941). Two non-blocking notes (shared location-settings version across the three settings screens; synthetic-drag evidence limitation) and three shared-state observations (undocumented `both()` trailing-slash convention, undocumented shared settings version, minor skill typecheck-heap drift) are recorded above.
